name: Behind-the-back wrist curl
cues: Keep your head up. Don't compensate with other muscles.

name: Wall sit
cues: Keep your head up, don't push on your legs with your hands, focus on the thighs.

name: Inchworm
cues: Don't rush, reach as far as you can, and control how your hands land on the floor.

name: Crunch
cues: Focus on the abs; don't just move your neck; don't rest your shoulders on the floor.

name: Cross-body crunch
cues: Focus on the abs; don't just move your neck; don't rest your shoulders on the floor.

name: Seated dumbbell curl
cues: Slow movement. Don't rest your elbow on your thigh. Don't go all the way down.

name: Standing dumbbell curl
cues: Keep your back straight, don't fully lock the arms, don't swing with shoulders or back.

name: Standing barbell curl
cues: Keep your back straight, don't fully lock the arms, don't swing with shoulders or back.

name: Standing neutral-grip triceps extension
cues: Keep your back straight, don't fully lock the arms, don't swing with shoulders or back.

name: Barbell bench press
cues: An arched back is fine. Feet planted, shoulder blades squeezed, wrists straight.

name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: An arched back is fine. Feet planted, shoulder blades squeezed, wrists straight.

name: Close-grip bench press
cues: An arched back is fine. Feet planted, shoulder blades squeezed, wrists straight.

name: Incline barbell bench press
cues: An arched back is fine. Feet planted, shoulder blades squeezed, wrists straight.

name: Incline dumbbell press
cues: An arched back is fine. Feet planted, shoulder blades squeezed, wrists straight.

name: Dips
cues: Don't let the elbows flare out; keep the legs still.

name: Dumbbell shrug
cues: Head up, arms locked, raise the shoulders while bringing them slightly forward, slow tempo.

name: Dumbbell flye
cues: Elbows slightly bent and fixed through the whole movement; chest out.

name: Windshield wiper
cues: Focus on the core; no momentum, don't push with your hands.

name: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension
cues: Stay braced, focus on the triceps, head straight and eyes fixed.

name: Barbell lunge
cues: Back straight, feet hip-width apart.

name: Bulgarian split squat
cues: Back straight; turn the dumbbell 90° on the side of the leg on the bench.

name: Jump lunge
cues: Stay explosive and braced, head up.

name: Bench wrist curl
cues: No jerking. Cracking wrists are fine, pain is not.

name: Spider plank
cues: Hands as far from the feet as possible. Too easy? Lift one hand or one foot.

name: Side plank
cues: Don't push with your arm, focus on the core. Harder: lift the top leg.

name: Seated hammer curl
cues: Slow movement. Don't rest your elbow on your thigh. Don't go all the way down.

name: Standing hammer curl
cues: Keep your back straight, don't fully lock the arms, don't swing with shoulders or back.

name: Straight-leg hold
cues: Hands under the glutes if needed, eyes on the ceiling, heels off the floor. Variations: flutter kicks, scissors, small circles, knee tucks, alternating legs.

name: Jefferson curl
cues: Potentially dangerous: go slow, perfect form, keep the load light.

name: Leg curl
cues: Explosive up, controlled down. Letting the stack bounce is OK if the descent stays controlled.

name: Leg extension
cues: Explosive up, controlled down. Letting the stack bounce is OK if the descent stays controlled.

name: Barbell calf raise
cues: Explosive up, controlled down, eyes forward.

name: High knees
cues: Very fast; drive with the arms; stay on your toes.

name: Mountain climbers
cues: Very fast, stay braced, heels off the floor.

name: Bent-over reverse dumbbell fly
cues: Elbows can bend slightly; spine straight, head up; not aggressive.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
cues: Stay very upright; cracking shoulders are fine without pain; bring the elbows slightly forward.

name: Heel touches (penguin)
cues: Focus on the core; no momentum; keep the shoulders off the floor.

name: Plank up-down
cues: Stay braced, limit hip sway, don't drop onto your arms.

name: Plank
cues: Braced, back straight at a constant height, head neutral. Harder: lift one leg.

name: Push-up
cues: Cracking elbows are fine without pain. Quality over quantity.

name: Archer push-up
cues: Cracking elbows are fine without pain. Quality over quantity.

name: Decline push-up
cues: Cracking elbows are fine without pain. Quality over quantity.

name: Diamond push-up
cues: Cracking elbows are fine without pain. Quality over quantity.

name: Wide push-up
cues: Cracking elbows are fine without pain. Quality over quantity.

name: Shoulder-tap push-up
cues: Cracking elbows are fine without pain. Quality over quantity.

name: Close-grip push-up
cues: Elbows tucked. Cracking elbows are fine without pain. Quality over quantity.

name: Pike push-up
cues: Cracking elbows are fine without pain. Quality over quantity.

name: Spiderman push-up
cues: Cracking elbows are fine without pain. Quality over quantity.

name: Dumbbell pullover
cues: Arms semi-straight; an arched back is fine; eyes on the ceiling.

name: Preacher curl (straight bar)
cues: Don't go all the way up, only while there is tension; focus on the biceps.

name: Preacher curl (EZ bar)
cues: Don't go all the way up, only while there is tension; focus on the biceps.

name: Hammer-grip preacher curl
cues: Don't go all the way up, only while there is tension; focus on the biceps.

name: Ab rower
cues: Back straight, eyes forward; feet and shoulders never touch the floor.

name: Weighted ab rower
cues: Back straight, eyes forward; feet and shoulders never touch the floor.

name: Ab wheel rollout
cues: Mind your lower back; slow; hold about 5 s fully extended.

name: Barbell row
cues: Back and spine straight, no jerking, don't go all the way down.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: Back and spine straight, no jerking, don't go all the way down.

name: Neutral-grip row
cues: Back and spine straight, no jerking, don't go all the way down.

name: Russian twist
cues: Focus on the core, not too fast, feet off the floor.

name: Weighted Russian twist
cues: Focus on the core, not too fast, feet off the floor.

name: Deadlift
cues: Back straight, bar close to the shins, don't rest it on the floor, sync knees and back.

name: Back squat
cues: Back straight, hips back, feet, knees and bar in line.

name: Sumo squat
cues: Back straight, hips back, feet, knees and bar in line.

name: Jump squat
cues: Explosive up, controlled down, stay on your toes.

name: Superman
cues: Eyes forward, careful with the lower back and neck.

name: Quadruped kickback
cues: Eyes on the floor, lift the leg high; add a band for more resistance.

name: Butt kicks
cues: Very fast; drive with the arms; stay on your toes.

name: Lat pulldown
cues: Back straight, leaning slightly back; pull to the chest explosively, control the way up.

name: Underhand lat pulldown
cues: Back straight, leaning slightly back; pull to the abs explosively, arms close to the body.

name: Toe-touch crunch
cues: Not reaching the feet is fine; shoulders off the floor; focus on the abs.

name: Barbell upright row
cues: Back straight, no momentum, elbows above the bar, control the descent.

name: Bench dips
cues: Back straight, arms close to the body, eyes forward, hips stay on the same vertical line.

name: V-sit
cues: Hold the V as much as possible; balance with your arms without using them for support.

name: Band woodchopper
cues: Slow; you can lean on a wall; don't recruit other muscles.

name: Seated overhead barbell triceps extension
cues: Stay braced, elbows pointing up, control the stretch.

name: Barbell overhead press
cues: Glutes and abs tight, bar path close to the face, lock out overhead.

name: Skull crusher
cues: Elbows fixed and pointing up, lower to the forehead under control.

name: Dumbbell triceps kickback
cues: Upper arm parallel to the floor and still; squeeze at full extension.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
cues: Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbows, no swinging.

name: L-sit
cues: Shoulders down, legs straight and level.

name: Concentration curl
cues: Elbow against the inner thigh, slow negative.

name: Pull-up
cues: Full hang to chin over the bar, no kipping.

name: Archer pull-up
cues: Pull towards one hand, the other arm stays straight.

name: Barbell shrug
cues: Straight up, short pause at the top, no rolling.

name: Renegade row
cues: Plank position, hips square, row one dumbbell at a time.

name: Pistol squat
cues: Heel down, free leg straight in front, control the descent.

name: Barbell hip thrust
cues: Chin tucked, full hip extension, squeeze the glutes at the top.

name: Dumbbell archer squat
cues: Wide stance, shift onto one leg, the other stays straight.
